notes.title: Game Update: Build 140
notes.notes: In order to fix a few strange and peculiar issues, logins were temporarily disabled and the game was update to build 140. The issues should be fixed, but if you encounter any problems within the game, be sure to either post in the forums or email Support@EFUniverseGames.com right away.

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
Majula Frontier: The Offense is now available to play!

If you have questions about the mechanics, there's a mechanics thread in the forums.

If you experience issues, be sure to post in the forums or email Support@EFUniverseGames.com
